text:
Alex Chen (AE): Uploading customer PO + ask: need legal sign-off on MSA redlines and confirmation of who signs the order form. Attachment: Acme_PO_4532.pdf
Nina Patel (Solutions): Quick context: POC passed, they want Dedicated capacity. Billing wants PO before countersign.
Dan Park (SalesOps): Do we need vendor W-9 + PO number mapping for e-invoice? If yes, tell finance to expect.
Mika Gomez (Legal): I'll review MSA+DPA redlines. Any specific clauses they edited? paste diff or upload doc.
Alex Chen (AE): They shortened SLA to 99.5% and added "no-liability for inference errors" clause. Uploaded redline: Acme_MSA_redline.docx
Nina Patel (Solutions): Also flagged KMS requirement — customer-managed keys (BYOK) + HSM mention in order form.
Mika Gomez (Legal): Customer-managed KMS is material. Need SecOps + Infra sign-off. @Dan, can you get the technical spec?
Dan Park (SalesOps): Looping @owen (Infra) — can you confirm if we support per-tenant HSM in Private today?
owen (Infra): We support BYOK for Private via standard KMS integrations, but full HSM-backed custody needs an SLA addendum and Infra runbook. ETA: 2 business days for full doc.
signer-bot: :white_check_mark: Acme_PO_4532.pdf uploaded. Please confirm Redwood signer email and customer signer addresses.
Alex Chen (AE): Customer signer emails: procurement@acme.co (PO), legal@acme.co (MSA), execsign@acme.co (exec countersign). They want DocuSign and countersign copy to finance@acme.co.
Mika Gomez (Legal): For exec signature we need signatory authority evidence (delegation). If order form lists a different signer, include delegation email + PO number.
Nina Patel (Solutions): Order form excerpt:
```
Customer: Acme Inc
PO#: AC-4532
Billing contact: finance@acme.co
KMS: customer-managed (BYOK)
SLA target: 99.5% uptime
```
Alex Chen (AE): Can Legal accept 99.5% for this deal to close POC faster? @Mika
Mika Gomez (Legal): Prefer to keep 99.9% default. If Sales accepts 99.5%, need GC risk approval and pricing offset. Propose a 6-month trial at 99.5% then revert to 99.9%, and document credits.
Dan Park (SalesOps): Finance: if SLA is 99.5%, we need a credit schedule line in the order form. Also require PO matching fields for invoicing (PO#, billing contact).
Alex Chen (AE): Customer willing to pay extra for KMS add-on to cover SLA delta. Can we add a one-time KMS onboarding fee? @Dan
Dan Park (SalesOps): Yes. Recommended line item: "KMS Onboarding (one-time) - $7,500". I'll add billing code and notes.
Mika Gomez (Legal): OK. I'll draft a minimal addendum: 6-month SLA exception + KMS onboarding fee + signatory delegation clause. Will insert comments in the redline doc.
Nina Patel (Solutions): Good. Next steps: Mika drops redline comments, Dan updates order form with onboarding fee and PO mapping, Owen provides infra caveats and runbook, Alex confirms final signer emails.
Alex Chen (AE): Confirmed signer emails again. procurement@acme.co, legal@acme.co, execsign@acme.co. Finance copy -> finance@acme.co.
Mika Gomez (Legal): I'll aim to post redline comments by EOD PST. If there are no new material blockers, we can route to Exec signature the following day.
Dan Park (SalesOps): When redline is posted, I'll create the DocuSign envelope and set roles: Redwood Exec -> legal@redwood.ai, Customer Exec -> execsign@acme.co, PO recipient -> finance@acme.co.
Alex Chen (AE): :thumbsup: Ping me when envelope is live. I'll coordinate customer side.
Nina Patel (Solutions): One more ask: please attach the KMS onboarding test plan as Appendix A in the order form so Security can sign off.
Mika Gomez (Legal): Good call. I'll have Appendix A added to the OF.
Alex Chen (AE): Expected close: Friday if redlines accepted. Will update thread with any changes.
